results.description: redeem on behalf of an owner without allowance reverts
redeem(deposit(a)) returns no more than a
withdraw(a) burns at least the shares deposit(a) minted
deposit(redeem(s)) mints no more than s
mint(s) costs at least the assets redeem(s) paid
withdraw(mint(s)) burns at least s shares
redeem(s) pays no more than mint(s) cost
mint(withdraw(a)) costs at least a
deposit(a) mints no more than the shares withdraw(a) burned
deposit does not revert for amounts up to maxDeposit (EIP-4626: maxDeposit is the most deposit accepts without reverting)
mint does not revert for shares up to maxMint (EIP-4626: maxMint is the most mint accepts without reverting)
withdraw does not revert for assets up to maxWithdraw (EIP-4626: maxWithdraw MUST return 0 when withdrawals are disabled)
redeem does not revert for shares up to maxRedeem (EIP-4626: maxRedeem MUST return 0 when redemptions are disabled)
